note: Zero-shot character probes for the LAION-CLAP music audio tower. Each axis scores a sound as the mean cosine similarity of its audio embedding to the positive phrasings minus the mean to the negative ones. 'center' and 'scale' map that contrast to 0..1: 1 / (1 + exp(-(contrast - center) / scale)). quality and lofi keep the phrasings written before any result; wet, bright and distorted were chosen on half of daw's CC0 validation set and scored on the other half (daw docs/research/clap-model-pack.md). punchy/soft was dropped: it did not reach AUC 0.8 held out, and daw measures attack and transient directly.

pos: a wet sound with lots of reverb
a drum hit with a long reverb tail
a sound with lots of high frequencies
neg: a sound with little high end

calibration: center: for wet, bright, distorted and lofi, the midpoint between the medians of the transformed and original copies in daw's CC0 validation set; for quality, the median over recorded CC0 and synthesized one-shots (0.5 = a typical sample there). scale: half the standard deviation of the contrast over the validation set. Monotone, so it changes no ranking.
